items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: That Gene Traxler was playing up on a contemporary hotel roof with the big Don Lamont band. And I was back home before I found out about that. And he was a marvelous bass player.

ctx.x: And Arthur Godfrey's old bass player was up there that used to do that radio show. And I can't recall his name. Traxler?
